title: Tsheko ka fa Tlase ga Makhubu
intro: Moporofeti mongwe, yo o neng a imetswe ke thomo ya gagwe, o ne a tsaya tshwetso e e neng ya mo isa kgakala le batho ba gaabo mme a tsena mo tekong e e neng e sa solofelwa. Loeto lwa gagwe lo ne lwa fetoga ka tsela e e gakgamatsang, lwa leka tumelo le bopelotelele jwa gagwe ka tsela e e tseneletseng thata. A o ka kgona go swetsa ka dintlha tsa tiragalo eno e e sa tlwaelegang go tswa mo dintlheng tse di go thusang?
clues: Moporofeti o ne a romelwa kwa bathong, mme a tsamaya ka bonako, a ikutlwa a kgobegile marapo ka go ganwa ga bone.
Loeto lwa gagwe lo ne lwa mo isa kwa lewatleng, koo a neng a palama sekepe se se neng se rwele dilo tse dintsi a batla tsela.
Go ne ga tsoga setsuatsue se segolo, se tshosetsa sekepe, mme ga dirwa tshwetso ya gore motho a le mongwe a latlhelwe kwa godimo ga lewatle go fokotsa morwalo, o o neng o laolwa ka bola.
O ne a mediwa ke sebopiwa sa boteng, tiragalo ya kgakgamatso e e neng e laotswe ke thato ya Bomodimo.
Mo teng ga melelwane ya mpa ya sebopiwa, o ne a bitsa Morena wa gagwe, a ikwatlhaya le go galaletsa Allah mo lefifing.
Morago ga nako ya go kopa thata, o ne a latlhelwa mo lotshitshing lo lo senang sepe, a le bokoa mme a tshela, mme moragonyana a boa go fitlhela batho ba gagwe ba dumetse kgabagare.

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Mosepele mo mpeng ya tlhapi e kgolo
Tshenolo ya sekgwa se se tukang
trial.answer: Mosepele mo mpeng ya tlhapi e kgolo

outcome.label: Botso
options: Tsalo e e gakgamatsang ya batho ba gagwe
Bogosi jo bo tlhometsweng losika lwa gagwe
Go boela kwa bathong ba gagwe ba ka nako eo ba neng ba dumela
Phenyo mo mmusi yo o bogagapa
outcome.answer: Go boela kwa bathong ba gagwe ba ka nako eo ba neng ba dumela

verse: And [mention] Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. But he called out within the darknesses, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.' (Al-Anbiya 21:87)
arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
